rationale: The metrics show a massive latency spike in recommendationservice (z=+893.38) that propagates to frontendservice, while traces confirm recommendationservice as the bottleneck in the slowest requests. The retrieved runbook attributes this degradation to conntrack/socket exhaustion causing dropped connections.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the system conntrack limit or fix connection pooling/leaks in recommendationservice to prevent socket exhaustion.
